Content Generation and Publication Policy

This Content Generation and Publication Policy ("Policy") governs all individuals, entities, and authorized third parties, including resellers and downstream users with passthrough access, who submit inputs to Hark's products and/or services (collectively, "Users"). This Policy is designed to ensure the lawful, ethical, and responsible use of our products and services and is incorporated by reference into our Terms of Service.

As set forth in our accompanying Privacy Policy and Terms of Service, our Services can generate Outputs based on Inputs. Such Outputs may consist of text, audio or voice recordings, images, videos, or any combination thereof (collectively, "Content").

1. Prohibited Content
The User represents, warrants, and covenants that the Content shall not contain, depict, or otherwise include any of the following prohibited material:
Sexually explicit, pornographic, or obscene material;
Graphic depictions of violence or material that incites, promotes, or glorifies violence;
Extremist propaganda, terrorist content, or material promoting radicalization;
Hateful content, including but not limited to hate speech, content promoting discrimination, or material targeting individuals or groups based on protected characteristics;
Dangerous challenges, stunts, or activities reasonably likely to be imitated by minors or that pose a risk of physical harm;
Content that promotes, encourages, instructs, or depicts self-harm, suicide, or disordered eating;
Content promoting unhealthy, dangerous, or medically unsound dietary or exercise practices;
Content containing appearance-based critiques, body shaming, or invidious comparisons;
Bullying, harassment, or intimidation of any individual or group;
Content that romanticizes, glorifies, or trivializes mental health conditions, including depression;
Targeted political persuasion, disinformation, or election interference material;
Promotion, advertisement, or facilitation of access to age-restricted goods or activities, including but not limited to illegal controlled substances, tobacco, alcohol (to minors), or other harmful substances;
Low-quality, misleading, or deceptive content created primarily for engagement manipulation, otherwise known as engagement bait;
Content that recreates, simulates, or appropriates the likeness, voice, or persona of (i) living public figures without their express written consent, or (ii) deceased public figures in contexts not authorized by their estate or applicable law;
Defamatory, libelous, or slanderous material; and
Content that infringes, misappropriates, or otherwise violates the intellectual property rights of any third party, including copyrights, trademarks, patents, trade secrets, or rights of publicity.
2. Restrictions on Use
The User further represents, warrants, and agrees that Content generated through the Services shall not be used to:
Identify, track, or surveil any individual without lawful authorization;
Solicit, infer, extract, or compile private, sensitive, or personally identifiable information about any individual;
Reproduce, simulate, or appropriate the likeness, voice, image, or persona of any individual without obtaining express written consent and all necessary rights, licenses, and permissions; or
Engage in commercial exploitation, including but not limited to commercial endorsements, advertising campaigns, merchandising, or any revenue-generating activity, without prior written authorization from Hark.
3. Content Sharing
Subject to compliance with this Policy, Users may share their Inputs and Outputs via social media platforms and livestream their use of the Services. Such activities are subject to the following mandatory conditions:
The User shall manually review and approve each Output prior to public dissemination or during any live broadcast;
The User's legal name, pseudonym, or business name, as applicable shall be included on all Content;
The User shall ensure that all Content is clearly labeled as AI-generated in a conspicuous manner that is likely to be understood by the average consumer;
No Content that violates this Policy, the Usage Policy, or that may reasonably be deemed offensive, harmful, or inappropriate shall be shared publicly; and
When interacting with the Services publicly in accordance with suggestions and Inputs submitted by viewers, the User shall exercise reasonable judgment and due diligence to ensure that such Inputs do not result in Outputs that violate this Policy or the Usage Policy.
4. Publication of Co-Authored Content
Users may publish their written works (including but not limited to books, anthologies, articles, or compilations) that were made, in whole or in part, with the assistance of the Services provided that:
The User's legal name, pseudonym, or business name – as applicable – shall be listed as author on all such publications;
The use of AI in the creation of the work shall labelled in a clear and obvious manner reasonably calculated to inform readers (e.g., in a foreword, introduction, acknowledgments section, or comparable location);
The User shall ensure that the subject matter of such work does not violate this Policy, Hark's Usage Policy, or Terms of Service, including but not limited to prohibitions on adult content, spam, hateful content, content inciting violence or hateful behavior, or content that may cause social, psychological or emotional harm; and
Users are strongly encouraged not to publish Outputs that may reasonably be expected to offend or harm others.
For purposes of clarity, Users shall not represent AI-generated Content as being wholly human-authored, nor shall Users represent human-authored content as being wholly AI-generated. The User assumes full and ultimate responsibility for all published Content, including compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and third-party rights.
The following disclosure language is provided for optional use by Users, provided such language accurately reflects the User's creative process:
"The author generated portions of this text using [Model Name], a large language model developed by [Developer Name]. The author subsequently reviewed, edited, and revised the AI-generated draft and assumes full responsibility for the content of this publication."
5. Reporting Violations; Enforcement
Users are obliged to promptly report Content that they reasonably believe violates this Policy or any other applicable Hark policy through our designated reporting mechanism.
Hark reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to investigate reported violations and to take any action it deems appropriate, including but not limited to removal of Content, suspension or termination of User accounts, and referral to law enforcement authorities where warranted.
Hark's failure to enforce any provision of this Policy shall not constitute a waiver of such provision or Hark's right to enforce such provision at a later time.
